name: MAVIN Furniture
old_description: Transform your workspace into a reflection of you with MAVIN's new Home Office Collection.
about:
MAVIN Furniture operates from Dundee, Ohio, where it produces American-made custom wood furniture. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The manufacturer offers a range of residential furniture collections, including a Home Office line, dining tables, the South Port bedroom group, and artful dining chairs. Its products are distributed through a network of more than 700 quality furniture retailers across the United States. Specific facility size, headcount, annual volumes, or part-number counts are not provided.

MAVIN serves the residential furniture market, supplying retailers that cater to homeowners furnishing home offices, dining rooms, and bedrooms. The company's "Locate a Retailer" feature directs consumers to its nationwide dealer network, which spans coast to coast.

The company emphasizes its American-made origin and a design approach that pairs thoughtful design with flexible customization, allowing customers to personalize pieces through an online design tool. This focus on made-to-order domestic production is presented as its core distinction.
built_on: Online design tool for product customization
Multiple residential collections (home office, dining, bedroom)
